إصغاءًا واهتمامًا بانشغالات الزبائن: Listening carefully and attentively to customers' concerns
وفاءً لثقافتها القائمة على التقرب من الز: True to its culture of customer proximity and innovation, Ooredoo Algeria is taking a new step in reinforcing its commitment to its customers by organizing a "Customer Week", taking place from October 4 to 8, 2026.
تُعد هذه المبادرة محطةً بارزة تواصل من خ: This initiative is a milestone through which Ooredoo Algeria continues the success achieved by Customer Day over the past four years. This new event is held under the slogan "Beyond what’s expected", extending this time over a full week. During this initiative, members of the management team, along with a number of employees from various departments of the company, will leave their offices to meet directly with customers and partners and closely understand their concerns and aspirations.
تتجسّد هذه التجربة الميدانية في لقاءات م: This field experience is embodied in direct and transparent meetings organized at Ooredoo spaces, partner points of sale, and customer service centers, as well as at the headquarters of the company's B2B customers. The initiative aims to directly listen to customers' experiences, aspirations, and suggestions, as well as to experience the daily lives of the frontline teams responsible for direct communication with them.
بهذه المناسبة، صرّح المدير العام لـ Oore: On this occasion, the General Manager of Ooredoo Algeria, Mr. Rony Tohme, stated: "At Ooredoo, active listening to our customers is not just a slogan, but a strategic compass guiding our path. Over four years, 'Customer Day' has enabled us to strengthen the unique relationship of trust we share with our customers. This year, we have chosen to intensify this approach by dedicating a full week to it through the launch of 'Customer Week'. Going out into the field, interacting directly with our customers, answering their calls, and visiting our enterprise partners are all practices that allow our leadership teams to remain in close contact with the daily reality of our customers. This direct proximity encourages us to continuously innovate and elevate the customer experience to the highest levels of quality and excellence."
من خلال تنظيم «أسبوع الزبون»، تؤكد Oored: By organizing the "Customer Week", Ooredoo Algeria reaffirms its commitment to embedding a culture of excellence, on both operational and human levels, at the core of its various decisions, thereby reaffirming its position as an innovative operator close to its customers, and firmly committed to meeting the expectations of millions of subscribers and enhancing their experience.
